changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment:
Issue #2893: coordinate maps 500 on upgraded instances. The v11.3.0 event-bag rename changed how origin.ip is typed across index generations: - pre-upgrade (v11.2.16) indices: origin.ip is dynamically mapped as text + .keyword sub-field. - post-upgrade indices (new template): origin.ip is typed "ip", which has NO .keyword sub-field. A terms aggregation on a TEXT field fails (fielddata disabled), so any pre-upgrade index in the time range makes the whole map request 500 (all shards failed).
Fix: bucket the maps on origin.ip.keyword, which exists and is aggregatable on BOTH generations (verified on OpenSearch 2.19.1: cross-generation terms agg on origin.ip.keyword -> successful:2 failed:0; on bare origin.ip -> failed:1). The installer template adds the fields.keyword multi-field to origin.ip for new indices so the keyword sub-field is present there too.
Idempotent: only rows whose bucket field is exactly "origin.ip" are updated; re-running is a no-op once it is origin.ip.keyword. Coordinate maps only (chart_type filter) - no id renumber/delete, so pinned compliance dashboards are preserved.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE utm_visualization SET aggregation = jsonb_set(aggregation::jsonb, '{bucket,field}', to_jsonb('origin.ip.keyword'::text))::text WHERE chart_type = 'COORDINATE_MAP_CHART' AND aggregation::jsonb -> 'bucket' ->> 'field' = 'origin.ip';
